description_en: Queries the statistics on the installation status of client plug-ins
description_zh: 查看客户端插件安装状态统计数据
name: DescribePluginSummary

parameters.help_en:
The name of the plug-in. Valid values:

alinet: AliNet.

alisecguard: Self-protection.

alihips: AliHips.

alidetect: AliDetect.

yundunmonitor: YundunMonitor.

This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns HTTP 400 and the error code -101
parameters.help_zh:
插件名称，取值：

alinet：AliNet。

alisecguard：自保护。

alihips：AliHips。

alidetect：AliDetect。

yundunmonitor：YundunMonitor。

本参数为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 HTTP 400，错误码为 -101
parameters.name: plugin_name

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The details of the plug-in data

FailedCnt.description_en: The number of servers on which the plug-in installation failed
FailedCnt.description_zh: 插件安装失败的主机数量

FailedReasons.description_en: The data on installation failure causes

Code.description_en: The error code for the installation failure

Count.description_en: The number of servers on which the installation failed due to this cause
Count.description_zh: 由于该原因导致安装失败的主机数量

Reason.description_en: The cause of the plug-in installation failure

OfflineCnt.description_en: The number of servers on which the plug-in is offline

OnlineCnt.description_en: The number of servers on which the plug-in is online

SwitchOffCnt.description_en: The number of servers on which the plug-in is disabled
SwitchOffCnt.description_zh: 未开启插件开关的主机数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
